source: Council of Ministers of Education, Canada (CMEC)
source_table: Measuring Up: Canadian Results of the OECD PISA Study — the PISA 2018, 2022, and 2025 reports (appendix trend tables B.1.14a/B.1.15a and the two-cycle tables 3.16–3.18); 2025 values cross-checked against OECD PISA 2025 Results (Volume I) Annex B2, Tables I.B2.1–3
frequency: every three to four years (one-time builder; re-run on the next CMEC report)
unit: PISA score points (mean) with standard errors as printed (link error included for non-baseline cycles)
transformations: science 2006–2025 from the 2025 report; mathematics 2003–2022 from the 2022 report plus 2025; reading 2000–2018 from the 2018 report plus 2022 and 2025
overlapping cycles verified across reports; Canada verified against the OECD national series; 2025 provincial means verified against the OECD regional annex
caution = the reports' note that 2022 and 2025 results for Canada and all provinces except Prince Edward Island, New Brunswick, and Saskatchewan did not meet one or more PISA technical standards
notes: PISA 2025 (science the major domain) published 8 September 2026. Maintenance ritual pisa_results.
